name: crank
description: Crank-loop workflows for Kimi Code — adversarial review, read-only exploration, implementation planning, and task-spec execution
author: Luan Moreno Medeiros Maciel

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial review, exploration, planning, and task-spec execution workflows
interface.longDescription: The crank-loop methodology packaged as native Kimi Code slash commands: /crank:review for structured reviews, /crank:challenge for adversarial design review, /crank:explore for read-only codebase analysis, /crank:plan for implementation planning, and /crank:run to execute tasks/T-*.md specs.
